title: Scenario 3, Task 2: The Future of the Semiconductor Industry: An HTML Slide Presentation
old_notes: The delivered HTML deck, slides.json, build scripts and README substantiate an 18-slide, browser-navigable, end-2026 semiconductor outlook with sourced research, explicit investment implications (sleeve sizing, hedge) and a risk section plus monitoring dashboard. Minor residual issues remain: the risk reviewer's final verification could not read the revised deck directly, and some caveats (modelled rather than realised vols, unverified NVIDIA leadership item, Taiwan look-through not computed) are disclosed rather than resolved, so internal consistency is not fully closed out.
new_notes: The HTML deck is complete, self-contained and navigable (arrow keys, fullscreen, print-to-PDF), with 18 substantive slides covering the full value chain, six judgments, three scenarios with probabilities, six implications, a sized portfolio with risk budget and hedge, a risk table, a monitoring dashboard and a sourced appendix. Research is dated and tagged, and the team clarified focus/audience with the human up front.
